plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 15 Nov 1941 & Jan 1955 (George Beadle and Edward Tatum irradiate Neurospora bread mould at Stanford to prove One Gene–One Enzyme, and George Palade discovers ribosomes at the Rockefeller Institute) · 15 Apr 1960 – Dec 1961 (Sydney Brenner, François Jacob, and Matthew Meselson discover messenger RNA in Cambridge and Caltech, and Francis Crick and Brenner prove the 3-letter triplet codon reading frame) · 27 May 1961 – 1968 (Marshall Nirenberg and Heinrich Matthaei decode UUU = Phenylalanine at 3:00 a.m. in Bethesda, and with Har Gobind Khorana and Robert Holley complete the 64-codon genetic code, winning the 1968 Nobel Prize).
